name: After § 2
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 2a. Calls on the Commission to act on the recommendation made by the Court of Auditors (the 'Court') in Special Report 22/2020 which advises the Commission to increase the use of cross-cutting evaluations of agencies in the context of the Commission’s fitness checks of different policy areas; insists, moreover, that evaluation results should be used to identify synergies and possible changes, including, where appropriate, the merging of agencies, in order to improve efficiency and eliminate redundancies; highlights that, where relevant, such evaluations should also explore ways to enhance governance structures while ensuring agencies remain effective.
